const prior = new Set($('Collect URLs R1').first().json.trace.map(t => String(t.query).toLowerCase()));
return $json.follow_up_queries.filter(q => !prior.has(String(q.query).toLowerCase())).map(q => ({ json: { query: q.query.slice(0,400), topic: q.topic, reason: q.reason, round: 1 } }));
